# Clean-up environment

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects includuing hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE) # Print everything without truncation, avoid scientific notation, keep strings as characters, silence dplyr’s “grouped output” informational messages
set.seed(42) # set seed for reproducibility
```

# Load Libraries

```{r}
# Core tidyverse
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Single Cell
library(Seurat) # Seurat (relies on dplyr/tidyr, so load after tidyverse)
```

# Set project directories and file paths

```{r}
project_name <- "20251104_sophieWiszniak_ncc_pa"

base_repo_dir <- "/home/melanie-smith/workDir/sophieWiszniak"
project_repo_dir <- file.path(base_repo_dir, project_name)
out_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir")
downloads <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "downloads")

cell_type_object_path <- file.path(out_dir, "06-cluster_marker_genes", "final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds")
sophie_clusters_v2_file <- file.path(downloads, "seurat_clusters_SW2026-09-23.csv")

new_col_name <- "sophie_seurat_clusters_v2"
```

# Load required objects
- `final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds` is the canonical, already-final object produced by `06.1-cellType_filter.Rmd`.
- We load it as-is (no re-embedding / re-clustering) so the existing `seurat_clusters`, `new_celltypes`, UMAP etc. are completely untouched - this script only adds one new metadata column.

```{r}
final_interesting_cells_0.6 <- readRDS(file = cell_type_object_path)

stopifnot(inherits(final_interesting_cells_0.6, "Seurat"))

# Sophie's new, more finely annotated cluster labels (whole merged dataset)
sophie_clusters_v2 <- read_csv(sophie_clusters_v2_file)
```

# Sanity check barcode overlap
- Confirmed interactively before writing this script: all 24,327 barcodes in Sophie's CSV match `colnames(final_interesting_cells_0.6)` exactly (same format, e.g. `AAACCCACAGACTCTA-1_1_1`) - no barcode reformatting needed here, unlike the original `03.2-cellType_annotations.Rmd` join.
- Re-checking here so the Rmd is self-contained and will fail loudly if that ever changes (e.g. Sophie sends an updated file).

```{r}
cat("Cells in final_interesting_cells_0.6:", ncol(final_interesting_cells_0.6), "\n")
cat("Rows in Sophie's CSV:", nrow(sophie_clusters_v2), "\n")
cat("Duplicated barcodes in CSV:", sum(duplicated(sophie_clusters_v2$Barcode)), "\n")

n_matched <- sum(sophie_clusters_v2$Barcode %in% colnames(final_interesting_cells_0.6))
cat("CSV barcodes found in Seurat object:", n_matched, "/", nrow(sophie_clusters_v2), "\n")

n_covered <- sum(colnames(final_interesting_cells_0.6) %in% sophie_clusters_v2$Barcode)
cat("Seurat object cells covered by CSV:", n_covered, "/", ncol(final_interesting_cells_0.6), "\n")

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(sophie_clusters_v2$Barcode),
  n_matched == nrow(sophie_clusters_v2),
  n_covered == ncol(final_interesting_cells_0.6)
)
```

# Add Sophie's new clusters as a new metadata column
- Added as `r new_col_name` - `seurat_clusters` and `new_celltypes` are NOT touched.
- Sophie's CSV column is also called `seurat_clusters`, so it's renamed on import to avoid any confusion with the object's existing column of the same name.

```{r}
sophie_clusters_v2_meta <- sophie_clusters_v2 %>%
  dplyr::rename(!!new_col_name := seurat_clusters) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Barcode")

final_interesting_cells_0.6 <- AddMetaData(
  object = final_interesting_cells_0.6,
  metadata = sophie_clusters_v2_meta,
  col.name = new_col_name
)

# confirm existing columns are unchanged and the new column is populated with no NAs
stopifnot(
  "seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(final_interesting_cells_0.6@meta.data),
  "new_celltypes" %in% colnames(final_interesting_cells_0.6@meta.data),
  !anyNA(final_interesting_cells_0.6@meta.data[[new_col_name]])
)
```

# Sanity checks - compare Sophie's new clusters against our existing calls

```{r}
# how does Sophie's new column relate to our current seurat_clusters?
table(
  final_interesting_cells_0.6$seurat_clusters,
  final_interesting_cells_0.6@meta.data[[new_col_name]],
  useNA = "ifany"
)

# how does it relate to our current top-level new_celltypes?
table(
  final_interesting_cells_0.6$new_celltypes,
  final_interesting_cells_0.6@meta.data[[new_col_name]],
  useNA = "ifany"
)

```

```{r}
# Visual sanity check - our existing UMAP, recoloured by Sophie's new clusters
DimPlot(final_interesting_cells_0.6,
        reduction = "umap",
        group.by = new_col_name,
        label = TRUE,
        repel = TRUE,
        label.size = 3) +
  NoLegend() +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP (existing embedding) - Sophie's new clusters (v2)",
    caption = "final_interesting_cells_0.6 + sophie_seurat_clusters_v2"
  )

ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir, "06-cluster_marker_genes", "06.2-umap.final_interesting_cells_0.6.sophie_clusters_v2.png"),
       width = 10,
       height = 8)
```

# Save
- Back up the existing object first (new column only - this is otherwise a drop-in replacement), then overwrite `final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds` in place so every downstream script that reads this file picks up the new column automatically once re-run.

```{r}
backup_path <- file.path(
  out_dir, "06-cluster_marker_genes",
  paste0("final_interesting_cells_0.6_pre_sophie_clusters_v2_backup_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"), ".rds")
)
file.copy(cell_type_object_path, backup_path, overwrite = FALSE)

write_rds(x = final_interesting_cells_0.6,
          file = cell_type_object_path)
```
